name: CentralConstantAccelerationEngine
description: Engine applying constant acceleration to all bodies, towards a central body. Ignoring the distance between them.

attributes.name: mask
attributes.description: If mask defined, only bodies with corresponding groupMask will be affected by this engine. If 0, all bodies will be affected.

attributes.name: reciprocal
attributes.description: If true, acceleration will be applied on the central body as well.
